shortBulletSummary: Overall market sentiment is "Neutral" (47-56) according to some Fear & Greed indexes, though others still show "Greed".
Bitcoin (BTC) is consolidating around $84K, struggling to break higher despite significant spot ETF inflows.
Surging US Treasury yields (above 5.2%) are creating a broader risk-off phase and headwinds for crypto markets.
Several altcoins (e.g., GT, CRO, SEI, STX, DOT) are showing rallies driven by specific news, upgrades, or tokenomics.
Trump's rejection of an Iran ceasefire proposal removed a primary macro tailwind for Bitcoin.
